prompt: Subject: Rooftop terrace knit top Subject: A 20-something woman kneeling on the wooden floor of a lush rooftop terrace, with one hand behind her head. The full body is placed large in the center, featuring an ecru openwork knit top and a pale floral mini skirt. Person/Expression: Slightly long oval face with a slender jaw, horizontal dark brown eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, a clear bridge of the nose, and pale pink lips. Head tilted slightly to the left looking at the camera with a calm expression and a relaxed mouth. Dark brown hair reaching the shoulders. Clothing/Pose: Ecru sleeveless cropped knit top. Clear wide round neck, vertical sheer coarse knit stitches, and ribbed hem below the chest. A high-waisted short skirt with a white background with ochre and gray-blue floral patterns. Pale beige sandals with thin straps. Both knees on the floor, right arm bent with hand behind the head, left arm lowered naturally. Background/Light: Foreground is a wood-grain deck, pots and wooden pillars on the sides, a wooden table and gray sofa in the back right, and city buildings further back. Strong direct sunlight from the top left brightens the face, shoulders, abdomen, and legs, creating hard shadows of leaves and the body on the floor. Composition/Camera: 3:4 vertical. Full-body portrait from a front camera slightly higher than the floor. Person placed large in the center, raised right elbow at the top left, both knees and sandals near the bottom edge. Texture/Style: Photorealistic live-action photo taken on a rooftop under clear skies. High-definition depiction of knit stitches, floral fabric, wooden floor, thin leather of sandals, and light on skin and hair. Negative: Change in kneeling pose; clogging of the openwork knit top.

promptZh: 主题：露台针织上衣 主题：一位 20 多岁 的女性跪在郁郁葱葱的露台木地板上，一只手放在脑后。全身像位于画面中心，身穿 米色 镂空针织上衣和浅色碎花短裙。人物/表情：略长的椭圆形脸，下颌线条纤细，深褐色横向眼眸，细长的平行眉，鼻梁清晰，淡粉色嘴唇。头部微微向左倾斜，神情平静，嘴角放松，直视镜头。深褐色齐肩长发。服装/姿势：米色无袖短款针织上衣。清晰的宽圆领，垂直的透视粗针织纹理，胸下有罗纹下摆。高腰短裙，带有 白色底色配赭石色和灰蓝色碎花图案。浅米色细带凉鞋。双膝跪地，右臂弯曲，手置于脑后，左臂自然下垂。背景/光线：前景为木纹露台，两侧有花盆和木柱，右后方有木桌和灰色沙发，远处是城市建筑。来自左上方的强烈直射阳光照亮了脸部、肩部、腹部和腿部，在地面上投下树叶和身体的硬朗阴影。构图/相机：3:4 竖构图。从略高于地面的正面拍摄的全身肖像。人物居中且比例较大，右肘抬起位于左上方，双膝和凉鞋靠近底部边缘。纹理/风格：在晴朗天空下的露台拍摄的写实真人照片。高清呈现针织纹理、碎花面料、木地板、凉鞋细皮带以及皮肤和头发上的光影。负面提示：改变跪姿；镂空针织上衣出现堵塞感。
